name: Basil Pesto Tortellini with Roasted Peppers, Zucchini & Parmesan
ingredients: 18 oz cheese tortellini, fresh or frozen
1 (12 oz) jar roasted red bell peppers
instructions: Wash, dry, trim, and medium dice zucchini. Transfer to a large baking sheet pan.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into thin pieces. Add to the baking sheet with the zucchini.
Drain and roughly chop roasted peppers, then add to the baking sheet. Drizzle veggies with oil and season with spices; stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring halfway through, until zucchini are golden and fork-tender, 15-18 minutes.

Meanwhile, fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add tortellini, and stir for a few seconds. Cook, stirring occasionally, until just tender, about 5 minutes (or cook according to package instructions).
When the tortellini is done, drain and return to the pot. Cover and set aside to keep warm.
When the veggies are done, remove from the oven. Add roasted veggies and pesto to the pot with the tortellini; stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls and top with Parmesan. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
